name: 993 Turbo/GT2 intercooler bracket, titanium F0 concept
description: Independent open two-rail bracket concept to screen the value of an LPBF remanufacture in Ti-6Al-4V. PorscheFanatics and the PET establish the circuit part numbers; FVD publishes the envelope and mass of a reinforced aftermarket bracket, without usable interface geometry.

classification.intended_use: CAD, DfAM, mass and mechanical screening of an intercooler bracket; no vehicle fitting authorized

provenance.record_license: MIT for the concept, the script and the calculations; no photograph, PET illustration or commercial geometry redistributed

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - PET transcription of the 993 Turbo groups
sources.notes: The catalogue locates the forced induction circuit and its brackets. It provides identity and context, but no dimension, tolerance or CAD surface. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-TURBO-PET.

sources.title: FVD - reinforced intercooler bracket FVD11011050
sources.notes: FVD declares 255 x 80 x 23 mm, 0.2 kg and a 993 Turbo/GT2 application. The envelope is kept; the rails, holes and central boss of the F0 are independent. See SRC-FVD-993-INTERCOOLER-BRACKET-DIMENSIONS.

sources.title: EOS Titanium Ti64 Grade 5 material data sheet
sources.notes: LPBF/DMLS process reference: anisotropy, machine parameters and heat treatment must be qualified. See SRC-EOS-TI64-GRADE5.

sources.title: TIMETAL 6-4 physical properties
sources.notes: Density, modulus, expansion and minimum yield of wrought sheet are used for screening only; they are not LPBF allowables. See SRC-TIMET-TI64-PHYSICAL-PROPERTIES.

material.grade: Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5 for screening; OEM material and FVD product unknown
material.standard: ASTM F2924 or equivalent supplier specification to be contracted

post_processing: support removal keeping access to the two open recesses
heat treatment qualified for the machine, parameters and orientation
HIP to be decided after fatigue analysis and defect population
machining of the end bores and central interface after clearances are defined
deburring, radiusing and finishing of load paths
passivation and galvanic isolation after dimensional inspection
supplier_requirements: traceable powder, machine, parameters, orientation, lot and powder recycling
witness coupons in critical orientations with representative tensile and fatigue
dimensional inspection of datums, center distances, bores and envelope
CT of nodes and bosses, then dye penetrant inspection after machining
contracted roughness, porosity, alpha case and residual stresses
instrumented static, vibration and thermal tests before any fitting

titanium.heat_treatment: Indicative EOS cycle to be confirmed for the selected machine and parameters; no recipe is frozen
machined_surfaces: mounting seats to be defined on a measured part
inspection: CT of bosses and rail junctions
tensile and fatigue coupons representative of the orientation
titanium.galvanic_isolation: Electrically separate the titanium from the aluminum intercooler and the steel fasteners with bushings, washers, coating and sealing qualified after the actual materials are identified.

known_limits: Only the 255 x 80 x 23 mm envelope comes from the commercial record; the rails, holes and central boss are F0 assumptions.
The published 0.2 kg mass concerns the FVD product whose exact material and topology are unknown; it does not validate the concept.
The 400 N central case, the 220 mm span and +120 K are synthetic; no 993 load has been measured.
The beam calculation ignores curvature, stress concentrations, contact, preload, vibration, fatigue, LPBF defects and thermal stresses.
The 828 MPa comparison limit comes from a wrought TIMET reference and is not an LPBF allowable.
The CalculiX C3D10 screen converges to within 10% on p95 and deflection, but keeps synthetic supports, load and elastic card; the local maximum still rises with refinement.
The derived USD passes the minimum structural check only; it carries no qualified SimReady physical attribution.
The STEP proves only a computable BREP within the envelope; it must be neither manufactured for fitting nor installed.
